name: Queenstown Airport

hours.v: the airport operates 07:00 to 22:00 daily, under Civil Aviation Authority rules
hours.quote: Under Civil Aviation Authority rules, Queenstown Airport operates between 07:00 and 22:00 daily.

curfew.v: no movements outside the operating hours of 07:00 to 22:00 local (the operator states the airport operates only between these times)
curfew.quote: Under Civil Aviation Authority rules, Queenstown Airport operates between 07:00 and 22:00 daily.

ppr.v: general aviation aircraft over 5,700 kg MCTOW and other non-scheduled flights must send a movement request by email or the website before operating; the airport then allocates parking if it can take the flight
ppr.quote: For non-Regular Air Transport Operations and General Aviation operations with aircraft that exceed 5700kg MCTOW, you must submit a movement request to us by email or website prior to operating.

handling.v: aircraft parking on the main apron must nominate a licensed ground handling agent; the airport may require one wherever you park; irregular operations of aircraft 5,700 kg MCTOW or more are directed to a ground handler (Queenstown Corporate Jet Services named)
handling.quote: You are required to nominate a licensed Ground Handling Agent(s) for the provision of Ground Handling Services

slots.v: Queenstown is a schedules-facilitated airport (the document says Level 3) under the IATA Worldwide Scheduling Guidelines, for regular air transport; general aviation over 5,700 kg uses the movement request
slots.quote: Queenstown is classified as a Schedules Facilitated Airport (Level 3) in accordance with the airport levels classifications contained in the IATA Worldwide Scheduling Guidelines.

runway.v: main runway 05/23 has a paved length of 1,889 m and is 45 m wide; crosswind runway 14/32 is 720 m paved and 40 m wide (operator's December 2023 master plan). This is paved length, not declared distances: the AIP was not read, and the airport's page of 21 Jan 2026 describes an EMAS arrestor bed, so use the AIP for performance
runway.quote: The main runway is aligned north-east to south-west and has a paved length of 1889 metres and a width of 45 m. ... The runway has a paved length of 720 m and a width of 40 m, with a 10 m sealed centre section.

max_aircraft.v: the operator's plan says the largest aircraft at Queenstown are and will remain narrow-body Code C (a planning statement, not a published limit); check any larger type with the airport
max_aircraft.quote: the largest planes to operate at Queenstown are, and will continue to be, narrow-body Code C aircraft

customs.v: not open-ended: non-scheduled and private flights must arrive during Customs working hours unless there are extenuating circumstances; arriving outside them needs approval at least 5 working days ahead; the hours are not defined. Queenstown is a listed Customs Place and Place of First Arrival
customs.quote: You must arrive during working hours unless there are extenuating circumstances.

permits.v: a foreign charter needs a New Zealand Foreign Air Operator's Certificate under CAR Part 129 (allow up to 90 days), unless it is a single landing and single take-off within any 28 days
permits.quote: they are classified as Air Transport Operations (ATO) and require certification under Civil Aviation Rule (CAR) 129. ... Permitted is a single landing and a single takeoff within any 28-day period without any certification.
